title: Crater outline and catalogue source cross-check
created_from: The regional terrain task; source archives retained under work/blender for reproducibility.
caveat: These geometries support overview framing and boundary review. Feature coordinate frame alignment remains provisional in each terrain asset.

tycho.source: LROC Copernican Craters (D > 10 km) shapefile, COPERNICAN_CRATERS_360
tycho.coordinate_reference: IAU Moon 2000 Geographic; the product README documents both -180..180 and 0..360 longitude domains.
tycho.geometry_type: LROC catalog polygon; traced rim not established
tycho.alignment_assessment: Catalog polygon provides a smooth outline and extent comparison only. Its documentation does not establish a traced rim or its control-network transformation to ME/DE421.

copernicus.source: LROC Copernican Craters (D > 10 km) shapefile, COPERNICAN_CRATERS_360
copernicus.coordinate_reference: IAU Moon 2000 Geographic; the product README documents both -180..180 and 0..360 longitude domains.
copernicus.geometry_type: LROC catalog polygon; traced rim not established
copernicus.alignment_assessment: Catalog polygon provides a smooth outline and extent comparison only. Its documentation does not establish a traced rim or its control-network transformation to ME/DE421.

clavius.source: Robbins 2018 global lunar crater database (PDS4), USGS Astropedia
clavius.coordinate_reference: The downloaded PDS4 catalogue records fitted circular/elliptical crater coordinates; exact rim vertices are not included in the CSV product.
clavius.geometry_type: catalogue fitted ellipse, not a rim polygon
clavius.alignment_assessment: Ellipse provides a size/center cross-check only. It does not replace a Clavius rim polygon or validate the exact edge/buffer.
